name: Orcaffein
description: Keeps a Mac awake with the lid closed while Orca agents are working, then gives sleep back once they stop or the Mac goes on battery. macOS only.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Orcaffein: starting. Press to pause or resume.

settings.title: Mode
settings.description: Agent: keep the Mac awake (lid closed too) while an Orca agent works, then for the idle time below. On: keep it awake whenever it runs on AC power. Off: never touch sleep. Same choices as Orca's own "Keep computer awake", which cannot hold a closed lid.

settings.title: Idle minutes before sleep returns
settings.description: After the last agent stops working, stay awake this long. If the lid is closed when it runs out, the Mac sleeps at once.

settings.title: Poll interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often to recount working agents and check power and lid state.

settings.title: Allow on battery
settings.description: Keep the Mac awake on battery too. Off (the default) gives sleep back as soon as the Mac is unplugged.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Absolute path of the orca command used to count working agents across all workspaces.
